label: Blue Hour Icon
description: The classic architecture money shot: a landmark glowing warm against cobalt dusk, long exposure on a locked tripod.
prefix: The definitive blue-hour photograph of an architectural icon — the fifteen minutes photographers plan whole trips around, interior light burning warm gold against a deep cobalt sky, a long tripod exposure silking every moving element away.
suffix: Blue-Hour Rendering: (the warm-cool color duel perfectly balanced:1.25), wet surfaces doubling every light, moving elements silked away by the long exposure, the building lit like a lantern from within.
negative: watermark, text, blown highlights, daylight flatness, midday sun, crowds
